title: Customizing vertical electrodeposition orientation and interfacial solvation to endow magnesium metal anodes with ultrahigh areal capacity
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01011J, Paper
Guyue Li, Liu Cao, Meng Lei, Keyi Chen, Chilin Li
3-Bromofluorobenzene as a facet-termination additive was developed to enhance the crystallographic orientation selectivity of Mg deposition and modulate the interfacial solvation structure of Mg2+ to realize Mg anodes with ultra-high areal capacity.
